snow_method: Kuchera snow ratio per model step from the profile at each resort's elevation, wet-bulb snow/mix/rain, minimum ratio 3:1 (snow_in); coarse models blend the 4 grid points around each resort
snow_regime_method: snow_in_regime: not published (always null); use snow_in
disclaimer: Experimental, automated model guidance for the Cottonwood Canyons. Not an official forecast; check the NWS and the Utah Avalanche Center before heading out.
